content: Robin Williams’ children are taking over their father’s Instagram account after his daughter spoke out against the use of his AI likeness, as reported earlier by The Wrap. In a post on Tuesday, Zak, Zelda, and Cody Williams write that they want the late actor’s Instagram profile to be a “safe, trusted place where the stories, photos, videos, and memories shared reflect his legacy with authenticity, warmth, and care.” A story posted to Zelda Williams’ own Instagram account expands on the decision to bring back her father’s profile, saying that it’s meant to help combat “rampant AI abuse,” according to The Wrap: > I’m sorry if anyone found Dad’s old page posting again to be triggering. Believe me, I know it’s a little strange. Making that space into one where people can find authentic clips and photos of him is one of the best ways we’ve now found to fight back against rampant AI abuse of his voice and likeness on here. Robin Williams’ Instagram account remained inactive following his death in 2014. Last year, Zelda Williams asked fans to stop sending her AI-generated videos of her father. “To watch the legacies of real people be condensed down to ‘this vaguely looks and sounds like them so that’s enough’, just so other people can churn out horrible TikTok slop puppeteering them is maddening,” she wrote at the time. [Media: https://www.instagram.com/p/DcJeJG_HM3g/] Though some AI chatbots have restrictions in place to prevent users from generating images or videos with the AI likeness of a public figure or celebrity, these guardrails can still be bypassed. OpenAI’s now-shuttered Sora app became a hotbed for generating videos of copyrighted characters and celebrities, while Grok is still generating sexualized AI deepfakes of famous women, according to Wired. ByteDance’s AI model, Seedance, also struck an agreement with the Motion Picture Association after lax guardrails allowed users to generate scenes with the AI likenesses of their favorite Hollywood stars. Bad actors have even used the AI likenesses of celebrities, like Taylor Swift and Rihanna, to push scams on TikTok. Zelda, Zak, and Cody Williams add that they’re going to use their father’s Instagram account to share his “unique talent and humor with the world.”
chineseTitle: 罗宾·威廉姆斯 (Robin Williams) 恢复 Instagram 账户以对抗“AI 滥用”
chineseSummary: 据 The Wrap 早些时候报道，在罗宾·威廉姆斯的女儿公开反对使用他的人工智能肖像后，他的孩子们正在接管父亲的 Instagram 账户。在周二的一篇帖子中，扎克、塞尔达和科迪·威廉姆斯写道，他们希望已故演员的 Instagram 个人资料成为一个“安全、值得信赖的地方，[...]
chineseContent: 据 The Wrap 早些时候报道，在罗宾·威廉姆斯的女儿公开反对使用他的人工智能肖像后，他的孩子们正在接管父亲的 Instagram 账户。在周二的一篇帖子中，扎克、塞尔达和科迪·威廉姆斯写道，他们希望已故演员的 Instagram 个人资料成为一个“安全、值得信赖的地方，在这里分享的故事、照片、视频和回忆以真实、温暖和关怀的方式反映了他的遗产。”据 The Wrap 报道，塞尔达·威廉姆斯 (Zelda Williams) 自己的 Instagram 账户上发布的一篇故事详细阐述了恢复她父亲个人资料的决定，称这是为了帮助打击“猖獗的人工智能滥用”： > 如果有人发现父亲的旧页面帖子再次被触发，我很抱歉。相信我，我知道这有点奇怪。让这个空间成为人们可以找到他的真实剪辑和照片的地方，是我们现在发现的反击人工智能滥用他的声音和肖像的最好方法之一。罗宾·威廉姆斯 (Robin Williams) 2014 年去世后，他的 Instagram 账户一直处于闲置状态。去年，塞尔达·威廉姆斯 (Zelda Williams) 要求粉丝停止向她发送人工智能生成的父亲视频。她当时写道：“看着真人的遗产被浓缩成‘这个看起来和听起来都像他们的人，所以这就足够了’，然后其他人就可以炮制出可怕的 TikTok 垃圾来操纵他们，这真是令人发狂。” [媒体：https://www.instagram.com/p/DcJeJG_HM3g/]虽然一些人工智能聊天机器人有限制，防止用户生成与公众人物或名人的人工智能相似的图像或视频，但这些护栏仍然可以被绕过。据《连线》报道，OpenAI 现已关闭的 Sora 应用程序成为生成受版权保护的人物和名人视频的温床，而 Grok 仍在生成著名女性的性感 AI 深度假货。字节跳动的人工智能
